headline: South African Rand and Markets Face Pressure From Strong US Dollar and Fed Outlook
summary: Symmetry financial analysis highlighted volatility for the South African rand amid US dollar strength, Federal Reserve interest rate expectations, and fluctuating Brent crude oil prices.
why: The South African rand (ZAR) is a major emerging market currency sensitive to global commodity prices and US interest rates.

impacts.name: South African Rand
impacts.why: The rand faced headwinds from US dollar strength and Federal Reserve interest rate expectations.
